name: TSMC Fab 20, Hsinchu (Baoshan)

process_nodes.label: N2
process_nodes.note: In production since late 2025; phases 3 and 4 are reported as production bases for processes below 2nm.

summary: A TSMC 2nm GIGAFAB in the Hsinchu Science Park at Baoshan. Construction began in October 2022, tools moved into phase 1 in March 2024 and N2 entered high-volume production at the Hsinchu site in the fourth quarter of 2025. Supply-chain reporting in February 2026 described the fab as producing, with expected output of 20,000 to 25,000 wafers a month, while civil works were under way on phases 3 and 4 for processes below 2nm. In October 2026 TSMC said N2 was ramping in multiple phases at Hsinchu.

location.address: 1, Kehuan Rd., Hsinchu Science Park, Hsinchu 308-001, Taiwan

metrics.note: Expected monthly output in 12-inch wafers reported for the fab in February 2026, when phases 3 and 4 were still in civil works; the report does not say which phases it covers.

milestones.note: N2 high-volume production began at the Hsinchu site.
